_comment: VERIFIED WORKING REFERENCE. This exact definition was published to a live Open Horizon hub and deployed to a real edge node, where the monitor detected its errors, analysed them with a local LLM, and wrote remediation proposals. Use it as a known-good starting point. It writes a heartbeat line every 20s and an ERROR line every 60s, so you can watch the whole pipeline work without wiring up a real failing service. Replace the org, url, image and command with your own.
label: Sample monitored workload
description: Emits periodic errors to a shared log path; opts into monitoring.

command: while true; do echo "$(date -Iseconds) INFO heartbeat ok" >> /var/log/out/app.log; sleep 20; echo "$(date -Iseconds) ERROR could not connect to database at db:5432: connection refused" >> /var/log/out/app.log; sleep 40; done
